title: Fix the Typo in a Typedef Name
description: The program should use a typedef alias for a Point structure.
expectedBehavior: The program should compile and print '1,2'.
actualProblem: The typedef defines the alias Point, but main() uses Pointt (with an extra 't'), which was never defined anywhere. The compiler reports 'unknown type name Pointt'.
explanation: A typedef creates an exact new name for a type, and that name must be used precisely wherever the type is referenced afterward. Any typo in the alias is treated as a completely unknown, undefined type.
